name: Halekulani
positioning: Beachfront Honolulu hotel that has welcomed guests for more than a century, with Seven Shades of White rooms, La Mer, Orchids and House Without A Key
best_for: Travelers who want beachfront rooms with views of Diamond Head, Waikiki Beach and the Pacific
Couples drawn to French-inspired fine dining and nightly live jazz
Guests interested in Hawaiian music, hula and the property's history

facts.text: Halekulani has welcomed guests on its beachfront grounds for more than a century.
Halekulani calls itself the House Befitting Heaven.
Rooms are decorated in a signature palette of natural, neutral tones called Seven Shades of White.
Each guest room has a private balcony, a deep soaking tub with separate glass shower and a Toto washlet.
Guest rooms include complimentary Wi-Fi and turndown service, with no resort fees.
Diamond Head Oceanfront rooms have views of Diamond Head, Waikiki Beach and the Pacific Ocean.
Premier Suite guests get a dedicated personal butler, in-room check-in and complimentary roundtrip airport SUV transfers.
La Mer's menu uses local and tropical ingredients in dishes inspired by flavors from the south of France.
Orchids celebrates the flavors of the coastal Italian regions, featuring local ingredients.
Sunday Brunch at Orchids has a carving station, omelet station, cold seafood selection and dessert station.
Lewers Lounge offers live jazz performances nightly.
SpaHalekulani incorporates Pacific healing traditions into its wellness treatments and salon services.

highlights.text: House Without A Key was immortalized in a 1925 Charlie Chan novel.
House Without A Key has nightly Hawaiian music and hula performances with a century-old kiawe tree as the backdrop.
The Halekulani Suite was designed by Vera Wang.
Halekulani guests get complimentary access to cultural venues including Bishop Museum, Shangri La, Honolulu Museum of Art and Iolani Palace.
The ground-floor Orchid Suite stands on the original site of the Lewers family residence and opens onto a private lawn.

considerations.text: La Mer admits only adults and children 8 years of age and older.
Reservations are not accepted for the daily hula show and sunset cocktails at House Without A Key.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
